task_scope: Prevent duplicate resident launches after parent restart; only permit a bounded recovery attempt after the persisted child's PID is independently observed absent.

required_nodes.rationale: A second parent cannot acquire the same state-root lifetime lock.
A present prior PID blocks new child launch; the supervisor neither adopts nor signals it.
A bounded restart reservation is durably recorded before a new exact child launch when the prior PID is absent.
Existing restart-budget and shutdown latches remain enforced.
Existing same-lineage unexpected-death recovery remains acceptance coverage.

execution_policy: Author only; do not execute during construction.
